title: Cognition Acquires Corridor to Bolster AI Code Security for Devin
summary:
The company behind the Devin AI agent announced it has purchased the startup Corridor to integrate expertise in the security of autonomous software development. Cognition said the deal is intended to expand the capabilities of its Devin Security offerings as part of a broader effort to address vulnerabilities in the global software supply chain.

Founded nearly two years ago, Corridor focuses on AI code security and the acceleration of secure software builds. The acquisition includes the addition of Corridor's engineering team to Cognition's operations to strengthen its position in the autonomous coding market.
